translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: ID POKITA
book.title: DOS ID POKITA ni Disas Krays ki Juan

content: Dos Pittun Ponolihan no id Piyod to Kotompusan no Kororattan

Nopongnga idda, nokita ku iddos ossa pa no oray'n mokososoobbun kotomanan diyot datas to langit. Duwon pittun ponolihan no id piyod to pittun kororattan, woy ini en kos kotompusan no mgo kororattan, su ka-ay en od kotaman kos langot to Monama.

Na, nokita ku iddos immat lanow no motingngow iling to oungan no duwon nokosambut no apuy. Nokita ku mandad dutun iddos mgo minuvu no id talu taddot moka-arat-arat no monnanap, oyyos waa ran en id simba taddot ribultu rin, woy waa ran mandad id pota-aw taddot numeru no idda en kos patow to ngaran din. Dos ipat sokkad kandan, id ponsomad to mgo alpa no id boggoy to Monama.
Id pongkanta ran to kanta ni Moises no uripon to Monama, woy kanta rad en mandad idda taddot Natin Karnero. Iddos kanta ran, mid ungketen to,

content.text: “Monama nod Longaggon no Motuus to Langun,
Oray'n motoos woy mokososoobbu kos pinuungan du.
Hari ka to langun no ingod.
Motallong ka woy ollog kos langun no po-ukit du!
Waa en ahad ondoy no waa allak kikow, od Longaggon. Waa ahad ondoy no diid posivantug kikow,
oyyos sikkow ra en kos uhis.
Dos langun no minuvu no id pomon diyot nokod-osso-osson ingod, od porani woy'd ponsimba kikow,
su nokita ran iddos langun no motallong no pinuungan du.”

content: Nopongnga idda, nokita ku no nopokesan kos templo no riyot datas to langit. Diyot daom tadda, nokita ku iddos lampas no Uhis no Lugaa no notawwan taddot nosulat no mgo suhu to Monama.
Woy pomon diyot templo, id leggua iddos pittun ponolihan no id piyod to pittu mandad no kororattan. Id oumpak dan to moputin ogget no mosella, woy duwon ollon no buawan diyot kabpa ran.
Na sokkad taddot oppat no ma-antoy'n binovallan, id boggoy rin diyot pittun ponolihan iddos pittun yohung no buawan no noponnut langot to Monamon ma-antoy taman to waad tomanon.
Dos templo, noponnut obboo no patow to se-aa to kotuusan din, woy waa en od poko-usok dutun taman tod kopongnga ron iddos pittun kororattan no id piyod taddot pittun ponolihan.
